summary: Add inactive per-job Linux scope readback and raw usage observations (unit 12b)

replay.detail: No claims, projections or replay paths change.

rules.detail: Gate-slot remains the admission path; these helpers are not wired into launch paths.

compatibility.detail: Additive internal Rust support only. All limits and heavy ceilings must be supplied by configuration; no policy defaults. io.weight is not an IO limit and has no effect with NVMe scheduler none.

downtime.detail: Inactive helpers require no service interruption.

manual.detail: No activation. Future unit 7 must apply and verify caps before the first process. Runtime provides raw CPU, peak memory, memory events and IO reads with per-read host time and host name; absent reads remain unknown.

recovery.detail: No durable state or host configuration is changed automatically.
